source_decisions.storage: Use the complete separate USBRPN archive. Contemporary USBR AF observations exactly match this archive on 2006-08-20 through 2006-08-26. Preserve the original USBR archive unchanged.
source_decisions.inflow: Retain original externally reported HORIZON USBR inflows except the quarantined 2006-08-23 value. Do not reconstruct missing inflow from fitting/assessment storage and release. Independence of reported inflows remains unverified.
source_decisions.inflow_exclusion_evidence: Archived inflow is 152000 cfs on 2006-08-23. Provider HGHM reports estimated unregulated QU=624.69 cfs and QD=2900 cfs. QU is a different estimated product and is not spliced into the calibration forcing. The anomalous interval remains missing.
source_decisions.physical_metadata: USACE 2022 Water Control Manual PDF page 19: gross maximum storage 3586783 acre-feet at 3565 ft, normal full pool 3467178 acre-feet at 3560 ft, physical dead storage 37131 acre-feet at 3196 ft. The DZTR hard storage ceiling includes surcharge storage and is not the normal operating target. Monthly operating targets are estimated from calibration observations.
source_decisions.storage_definition: Gross/total storage, matching USACE Table 2-1 and USBR AF; no datum offset added.
source_decisions.flow_clock: Declared daily means over nominal 86400-second intervals ending at the current storage row. Exact historical provider clock is not certified; assessment remains conditional.
source_decisions.channel_capacity: Calibration-only Hazen Q99 benchmark proxy; not a certified channel or outlet design capacity.
source_decisions.gap_initialization: Every forcing block starts at the frozen calibration-only generalized monthly normal storage. Hold out 30 days after each restart. No held-out observations initialize model states.
source_decisions.window: All complete calendar years in the combined 1987-10-01 to 2017-12-19 flow archive: 1988 through 2016. No year is discarded using model performance.
